{{Quote|Den how can yousa explain Vink un Nink ina sub pen? Or da dianoga un da Great Hohokum?|Jar Jar Binks to Roos Tarpals|<ref name="Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core">''[[Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core]]''</ref>}}
The '''Great Hohokum''' was a large and ancient [[Hohokum/Legends|Hohokum]] that was kept in the [[Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility]] in the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], it was more than four [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] old, and was considered to be one of the most important creatures in the facility, second only to the [[dwarf opee sea killer]]s [[Vink]] and [[Nink (dwarf opee sea killer)|Nink]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] accidentally deactivated half the [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubbles]] containing the wildlife, releasing several animals including the Great Hohokum.
